pr_title: ddl: Do not consider the clustered index when checking the length of the secondary index
pr_body:
<!--

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #29658 

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
It calculates the length of the secondary index to check constraint by the length of index self and the cluster index length before(ddl: fix secondary index len check for clustered index #23710) . Now it calculates the length of the secondary index only by self.
